evals.prompt: Convert our adaptive navigation shell (portrait NavigationBar + wide NavigationRail) and Preferences appearance selector to Material 3 Expressive widgets using package:material_3_expressive, keeping existing testability and theme mode switching.
evals.expected_output: Uses M3ENavigationBar, M3ENavigationRail (with M3ENavigationRailSection), and M3ESegmentedButton (with String M3ESegment labels), imports material_ui with hide CornerRounding, RoundedPolygon if both packages are imported, and never imports package:flutter/material.dart.

evals.prompt: Upgrade the Metronome BPM control section and transport bar to M3E components: replace the Slider with a medium M3ESlider and the Play/Stop + Tap Tempo controls appropriately without breaking zero-latency pointer-down Tap Tempo accuracy.
evals.expected_output: Uses M3ESlider(size: M3ESliderSize.m) and M3EButton for Play/Stop, while explicitly preserving raw Listener.onPointerDown for Tap Tempo rather than wrapping Tap Tempo in an ink-only button.

evals.prompt: Create a standalone M3E settings card + modal editor sheet snippet in Dart using package:material_3_expressive with an outlined card, an M3ETextField with clear button, a segmented toggle button, and a dialog confirmation.
evals.expected_output: Uses M3EMaterialApp or M3ETheme, M3ECard(variant: M3ECardVariant.outlined), M3ETextField(label: String, showClearButton: true), M3EButton, and M3EDialog.show / M3EBottomSheet.show with valid 1.2.1 constructor parameters.
